title: NSM-II data centre cooling, IIT Kanpur (liquid-cooled AI racks)
source: IIT Kanpur public tenders 12-AC-EE-2025 (HVAC schematic Drawing 2) and 04-AC-EE-2025 (1000 TR chiller plant contract documents); illustrative IT load scenario
question: Can the cooling infrastructure take 8 more direct-liquid-cooled GPU racks at 130 kW each (+1,040 kW on the CDU loop) with N+1 redundancy? What limits first, and what is the cheapest fix?
data_note: Real design data from IIT Kanpur's public tenders; the IT load scenario is illustrative. Muse reads this PDF schematic reliably (loops, equipment, connections). Its DWSIM model of this plant is not reliable yet: four build attempts missed the chillers or misplaced the rear-door exchangers, so no capacity answer is shown.
